title: Concept: Object element rendering a data document
description: An object element whose data is a data:text/html document in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The embedded document renders markup inside the page, and a reader who trusts the page can be led to interactive content that the page itself would never allow.
applicability: Deployments that render an object element whose data is a data:text/html document into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The embedded document renders markup inside the page, and a reader who trusts the page can be led to interactive content that the page itself would never allow.
